import re


def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    # Replace all non-alphanumeric characters (including spaces) with dash
    result = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", "-", text)
    # Remove leading/trailing spaces and dashes
    result = result.strip(" -")
    # Collapse multiple consecutive dashes to single dash
    result = re.sub(r"-+", "-", result)
    return result


def truncate(text, n):
    if len(text) <= n:
        return text
    return text[: n - 3] + "..."
